items.question: How many arms and faces characterize the twelve Ādityas?
premises: The twelve Ādityas are worshipped outside the pīṭha.
Their faces are either one or two.
items.inference: The Ādityas have a uniform two-armed form with variable facial count.
uncertainties: Whether one-faced and two-faced describe subsets or alternating forms is not explicit.
items.plain_english: All of them are to be known as two-armed, one-faced or two-faced.
